articles.title: Coinbase wants to be Canada’s ‘everything exchange,’ but says clearer rules are needed first
articles.snippet: Coinbase Canada's new CEO, Eric Richmond, says permanent rules, rather than temporary exemptions, are needed as the company pushes to expand into derivatives, tokenized assets and decentralized finance.

articles.title: Markets Don’t Buy the US Ceasefire Against Iran Will Last
articles.snippet: The odds that a ceasefire lasts at least 14 consecutive days dropped by 10% today on Polymarket, and traders on Myriad believe peace talks won't happen until next month.

articles.title: The Dumbest-Looking AI Prompt Just Beat Months of Careful Game-Design Prompt Engineering
articles.snippet: The dev told Claude Opus 5 to be "utterly perfect" and left the rest up to the model—the results turned out to be utterly perfect, for an AI model.

articles.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Will Arrive by September, Markets Predict
articles.snippet: Money is moving on a September bet for OpenAI’s next major model on both Polymarket and Myriad prediction markets.
